channel.title: Hussain Hakimi — Software Engineering Blog
channel.description: Articles on frontend development, software engineering, data analytics, and career growth by Hussain Hakimi, Software Engineering student at UET Lahore.

item.title: چگونه یک وب‌سایت سریع و زیبا بسازیم
item.dc:creator: Hussain Hakimi
item.description: نکات کلیدی برای ساخت وب‌سایت‌هایی که هم زیبا هستند و هم عملکرد عالی دارند. از بهینه‌سازی تصاویر تا کاهش حجم جاوااسکریپت.

item.title: مسیر من به سمت برنامه‌نویسی
item.dc:creator: Hussain Hakimi
item.description: داستان تغییر مسیر من از رشته مدیریت بازرگانی به مهندسی نرم‌افزار و اینکه چرا این بهترین تصمیم زندگی‌ام بود.

item.title: Building a Blazing-Fast Portfolio with Astro
item.dc:creator: Hussain Hakimi
item.description: How I built this portfolio using Astro to achieve perfect Lighthouse scores while maintaining a beautiful, interactive design. Learn about dark mode, command palette, and scroll animations.

item.title: Understanding Big O Notation: A Beginner's Guide
item.dc:creator: Hussain Hakimi
item.description: A clear, practical guide to understanding algorithm complexity and why Big O notation matters for every software engineer. Learn O(1), O(log n), O(n), and O(n²) with real examples.

item.title: Why I Chose Software Engineering Over Business
item.dc:creator: Hussain Hakimi
item.description: The story of how I pivoted from Business Administration to Software Engineering, and why it was the best decision I ever made. A guide for students considering a career change.
